translations.web: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.
translations.bsb: We, however, will not boast beyond our limits, but only within the field of influence that God has assigned to us—a field that reaches even to you.
translations.kjv: But we will ➔ not boast of things without our measure, but according to the measure of the rule which God hath distributed to us, a measure to reach even unto you.
translations.asv: But we will not glory beyond our measure, but according to the measure of the province which God apportioned to us as a measure, to reach even unto you.
